documents.title: Vaccine administration
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Shingrix #2, R deltoid. Says the first one gave him a sore arm and a tired afternoon, nothing more. Series now complete. Tolerated.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
S: Winter has been quiet for the lungs, albuterol a few times a week as usual. Home BP when he remembers, 140s-150s. Taking everything.
O: BP above goal in office. SpO2 normal on room air. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. Heart regular. No edema.
A/P
HTN: above goal, lisinopril 10. Discussed going up on the dose; he'd like to try cutting salt on the road food habits he kept from trucking first. Recheck summer.
COPD group B, stable, tiotropium plus prn albuterol.
Lipids: last panel steady, atorvastatin 40.

documents.title: refill
documents.author: patient
documents.body: Need the lisinopril refilled, the pharmacy says no more on the old one. Also the atorvastatin is getting low. Same place as before.

documents.title: RE: refill
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Both sent for 90 days with refills, should be ready this afternoon.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Follow-up visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Missed June, mixed up the date. Feels well. Home cuff readings he wrote on an envelope: high 140s, a few low 150s. Less takeout he says. Breathing at baseline, heat bothers him more than cold.
Exam: BP above goal. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. No edema, feet warm.
A/P: HTN still not at goal on lisinopril 10. Keep the log, revisit at the August physical with labs. COPD stable.

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Subsequent AWV.
Function: independent, still drives, does his own shopping and yard. No falls. No new memory concerns. PHQ-2 0.
Advance directive: still hasn't filled it out, another copy given.
Lungs: no exacerbations this year, CAT feels about the same to him. Uses albuterol 2-3 times a week, more on humid days.
BP: log average high 140s/high 80s. Office reading above goal.
Exam: heart regular without murmur. Lungs diminished, no wheeze or crackles. Abdomen soft. Pulses present in the feet, no edema.
Screening: colonoscopy due 2029. LDCT due November, ordered. Shingrix complete. Pneumococcal done.
Vaccines this fall: flu, COVID, and RSV is recommended at his age with COPD; he's agreeable, will do all at the nurse visit.
A/P: labs today with A1c. HTN above goal, lisinopril 10 unchanged. COPD stable. Lipids on atorvastatin 40.

documents.title: Results
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Your labs are all in a good range, including the A1c (no diabetes). Kidneys fine. Cholesterol where it has been. Nurse visit for the fall shots is on the calendar for late September.

documents.title: Vaccine administration
documents.author: RN
documents.body: Flu (high-dose) L arm, 2024-25 COVID R arm, RSV L arm separate site. Screening questions negative. VIS sheets given. Watched 15 min, no reaction.

documents.title: Tiotropium refill
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Refill request from pharmacy for tiotropium 18 mcg capsules, 90 days. Plan formulary unchanged this year, no prior auth needed. Sent, PCP to cosign.

reports.study: Low-dose CT chest for lung cancer screening
reports.text: Annual low-dose CT of the chest without contrast compared with 2022 and 2023. No pulmonary nodules. Lungs otherwise clear. No pleural effusion. No adenopathy. Cardiac size within normal limits.
reports.conclusion: Lung-RADS 1, negative. Return to annual screening.

documents.title: LDCT result
documents.author: PCP
documents.body: Third screening CT, still negative (Lung-RADS 1). Message to patient. Next one fall 2025.

procedures.procedure: Office visit, established patient, moderate MDM

documents.title: Follow-up visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Winter check. No chest pain, no leg symptoms, no fevers. Breathing about his usual, stairs slow him, he paces it. Albuterol a few times a week. Hasn't used the cuff much since the holidays.
Exam: BP high in office, recheck after 5 min still above goal. Lungs diminished, no wheeze. Heart regular. Ankles without swelling.
A/P
- HTN: above goal, on lisinopril 10. Asked him to restart home readings twice a day for two weeks and send them by portal. Will decide on adding or raising after that.
- COPD B: stable on LAMA.
- HLD: atorvastatin 40.

documents.title: Home blood pressure readings
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Hi Mr. Ryan, checking in: we haven't received the two weeks of home blood pressure readings the doctor asked for at your February visit. You can type them into a reply here or drop the paper off at the front desk.

procedures.procedure: Telehealth visit, established patient, low MDM

documents.title: Telehealth visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
Phone-and-video check, he was home. Never sent the two weeks of readings; says the cuff numbers he did take were 'mid 140s mostly.' Spring pollen hasn't set off his breathing, no change in inhaler use. No new complaints.
Plan: same medicines. Bring cuff and pills to the August physical, we'll settle the blood pressure plan in person with labs.

documents.title: Atorvastatin and lisinopril refills
documents.author: MA
documents.body: Pharmacy requesting 90-day refills of atorvastatin 40 mg and lisinopril 10 mg. Last BMP and lipids 8/2024, due again at the August physical. Sent per protocol.

documents.title: Annual Wellness Visit
documents.author: PCP
documents.body:
AWV, year 3 with us.
Functional review unchanged: independent, drives, no falls. PHQ-2 0.
COPD: no flares in the year. Albuterol a few times weekly.
BP: brought the cuff, it matches ours. Readings at home still mid to high 140s on top.
Exam: BP above goal. Heart RRR. Lungs diminished bilaterally, no adventitious sounds. Abdomen benign. Pedal pulses 2+ bilat, no edema.
Screening: LDCT due fall, will order with the vaccine visit. Colonoscopy 2029.
Plan: labs. Lisinopril 10, atorvastatin 40, tiotropium, albuterol continue. Fall vaccines in October.

documents.body: Flu high-dose L deltoid and 2025-26 COVID R deltoid given. RSV already done last year, not repeated. Annual lung CT order placed per PCP standing plan; scheduling will call him. Tolerated, waited 15 min.
